def _kernel(z, n, h, g, w, l, variant=0):
    a = (z - z[:n].mean(0)) / np.maximum(z[:n].std(0), 1e-08)
    b = z - g * np.sin(h * z)
    b = (b - b[:n].mean(0)) / np.maximum(b[:n].std(0), 1e-08)
    G = (b @ b.T + w * (a @ a.T)) / (4 * (1 + w))
    R = ((b[:, None] - b[None, :]) ** 2 + w * (a[:, None] - a[None, :]) ** 2) / (1 + w)
    r = np.exp(-R / l)
    m = r.sum(2)
    return (1 + G) ** 2 + m / 4 + (m * m - (r * r).sum(2)) / 12

def solve_batch(study):
    tr = study['train']
    n = len(tr['x'])
    z = calibrate(study['panel_a'], np.r_[tr['x'], study['test']['x']])
    y = tr['y']
    T = tr['traj']
    yh = np.mean([_pred(_kernel(z, n, h, g, w, l), y, n, r) for (h, g, w, l, r) in [(2.4, 0.4, 0.1, 15, 0.001), (2.9, 0.4, 0.4, 15, 0.001), (3.1, 0.4, 0.4, 15, 0.001), (3.1, 0.55, 1, 6, 0.005)]], 0)
    a = (z - z[:n].mean(0)) / z[:n].std(0)
    b = z - 0.4 * np.sin(2.9 * z)
    b = (b - b[:n].mean(0)) / b[:n].std(0)
    P = _pred((1 + (b @ b.T + 0.1 * a @ a.T) / 4.4) ** 2, T, n, 0.001)
    return {'y_hat': yh, 'state_pred': P, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([yh.mean(), yh.std(), P[:, -1].mean(), P[:, -1].std()])}

def infer(B, I, J, Y, penalty):
    from scipy.linalg import cho_factor
    from scipy.linalg import cho_solve
    from scipy.optimize import minimize
    p = len(B)
    Y = np.asarray(Y)
    sd = Y.std(0)
    M = (Y - Y.mean(0)) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-08)
    M = M.reshape(len(I), -1)
    m = M.shape[1]
    A = np.r_[B[:, I][:, :, I], np.eye(len(I))[None]]
    a = A.reshape(p + 1, -1)
    ref = np.r_[np.full(p, -3.0), -7.0]
    ref[0] = -1

    def obj(q):
        v = np.exp(q)
        K = (v @ a).reshape(len(I), -1)
        F = cho_factor(K)
        alpha = cho_solve(F, M)
        d = (cho_solve(F, np.eye(len(I))) - alpha @ alpha.T / m).ravel()
        return (np.log(F[0].diagonal()).sum() + np.sum(M * alpha) / 2 / m + penalty * np.sum((q - ref) ** 2) / 2, a @ d * v / 2 + penalty * (q - ref))
    O = minimize(obj, ref, jac=True, method='L-BFGS-B', bounds=[(-14, 5)] * p + [(-12, -2)], options={'maxiter': 160, 'ftol': 1e-07})
    v = np.exp(O.x)
    F = cho_factor((v @ a).reshape(len(I), -1))
    P = np.tensordot(v[:-1], B[:, J][:, :, I], axes=1) @ cho_solve(F, M)
    return (P * sd + Y.mean(0), O.fun)
